title: parameter visuals: diffusion models, GANs and state-space models
description: The `visual` kinds of the diffusion, generative-adversarial-network and state-space parameter records, referenced from parameter.schema.json. Inputs are copied from a named model's configuration or code; every value drawn is computed by the consumer from them.

caption.description: what is drawn and whose configuration or code it uses

schedule.description: one forward noise schedule as a Diffusers scheduler_config.json writes it; squaredcos_cap_v2 (Improved DDPM's cosine schedule) ignores beta_start and beta_end

noise_schedules_visual.description: ᾱ_t of each schedule at every step t = 1 … steps, with `marks` tabulated; sampling_steps above 0 instead marks that many steps evenly spaced from 1 to steps, rounded (Improved DDPM's striding), on the first schedule

unet_config.description: the keys of a Diffusers UNet2DConditionModel config.json that set its parameter count, copied from the named model's unet/config.json; projection_class_embeddings_input_dim is 0 for a model without SDXL's extra embedding

unet_levels_visual.description: the channels at each resolution level (base × multiplier) and each level's ResNet and attention parameters, counted as Diffusers builds the U-Net; compare_base above 0 recounts with that base width and the same multipliers

unet_attention_visual.description: at each level and in the middle block: the positions one attention layer compares (side²), the self-attention scores per head (side⁴) and the attention parameters; levels without attention are drawn empty

dcgan_config.description: a DCGAN-style network as the DCGAN authors' code builds it: z projected to start_size² × (multiplier × base_features) numbers, then layers that double the side up to image_size (generator) or halve it down to start_size (discriminator)

base_features.description: ngf for the generator, ndf for the discriminator

dcgan_layers_visual.description: the feature maps after each layer and each layer's weights and batch-norm values; `compare` names one value (latent_dim or base_features) to recount with

mamba_config.description: the keys of a Mamba config.json (d_model, n_layer, vocab_size, pad_vocab_size_multiple) and the block settings of the reference code (d_state, d_conv, expand; tie_embeddings as MambaConfig defaults it)

mamba_count_visual.description: one Mamba block's parameters by part, the count per block (or in total for n_layer) as `vary` takes each of `values`, and for d_state and d_conv the numbers each block keeps while generating, d_inner × (d_conv + d_state)
